_comment: Maps a broadcast network name (as reported by the schedule source) to a URL to open when a game on that network is dropped into a slot. There is no public API that hands out direct per-game deep links across streaming services, so most of these point at the network's general live/watch page rather than the exact game - you'll often still need to click the right game once the page loads. Edit freely to match your actual subscriptions (Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, Fubo, etc).
